narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The signs do not matter, so I add the circled numbers as if they were all positive.
<bookmark mark='line'/>But minus five and minus six move you down the number line, not up.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The sign tells you which way to move, so every sign must stay.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Circle a number, strike out its row and column, and repeat. Then add one number at a time with its sign.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Take the grid with one, two, three, then four, five, six, then seven, eight, nine.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Circle three numbers by the same rules. What do they add up to?
